title: Five-lane ECDLP audit route-registry seed

scope.purpose: Normalize candidate route families and typed hybrid links before a source-corpus-reviewed WS5 freeze.
scope.boundary: This seed is an incomplete planning inventory. Its entries are unassessed candidates, not findings, a historical census, or a universal attack denominator.

lanes.title: True ECDLP methods in the target group
lanes.decision_rule: Assign here only when the route computes the scalar from the public group instance without transporting the problem to a different algebraic object.

route_families.title: Exhaustive search and baby-step giant-step
route_families.scope: Generic exhaustive and time-memory tradeoff algorithms operating in the source group.
open_obligations: Freeze algorithm variants, exact workload identities, controls, and cost boundaries from the reviewed corpus.

route_families.title: Pollard rho, lambda, and parallel walk variants
route_families.scope: Generic collision or interval walks, including explicitly scoped parallel variants.
open_obligations: Separate one-target work from multi-target amortization and bind every comparison to a matched reference.

route_families.title: Automorphism-accelerated generic walks
route_families.scope: Source-group walks using verified automorphism or endomorphism equivalence classes.
open_obligations: Verify automorphism action, subgroup compatibility, quotient rules, and complete costs for each exact curve identity.

route_families.title: Hardware-accelerated generic algorithms
route_families.scope: Generic source-group methods whose constants change through CPU, GPU, FPGA, or other explicitly identified hardware.
open_obligations: Record exact hardware, operation unit, parallelism, memory, energy where claimed, and matched implementation controls.

route_families.title: Native relation and index-calculus methods
route_families.scope: Relation generation, decomposition, linear algebra, and recovery that remain formulated for the source group.
open_obligations: Require genuine relations, verified rank and target decomposition, matched rho, failures, duplicates, memory, and full runtime accounting.

route_families.title: Auxiliary-input and interval methods
route_families.scope: Source-group algorithms whose claim depends on disclosed auxiliary information or a bounded scalar interval.
open_obligations: State the auxiliary input or interval as part of the problem definition and prohibit transfer to unrestricted ECDLP claims.

route_families.title: Quantum discrete-log algorithms and resource estimates
route_families.scope: Quantum algorithms for source-group discrete logarithms, with physical-resource estimates treated separately from algorithmic existence.
open_obligations: Pin circuit model, error-correction assumptions, logical and physical resources, success probability, and verification scope.

lanes.title: Mathematical transfer to another algebraic object
lanes.decision_rule: Assign here when the target subgroup is transported to another object or representation and a source result must be recovered.

route_families.title: Pairing embeddings including MOV and Frey-Rück
route_families.scope: Transfers a source subgroup into a multiplicative group through an explicitly checked pairing and recovery path.
open_obligations: Verify embedding degree, non-degeneracy, subgroup injection, target solver, and recovery for each exact unit.

route_families.title: Anomalous and p-adic lift transfers
route_families.scope: Uses a checked anomalous-order condition and an explicit lift or logarithmic map with exceptional cases.
open_obligations: Separate the parameter condition from the executable map and verify lift, kernel, denominators, and source recovery.

route_families.title: Weil and GHS descent
route_families.scope: Moves a DLP through field descent or a higher-dimensional representation with explicit correspondence and recovery.
open_obligations: Pin field tower, dimensions, exceptional cases, subgroup image, destination algorithm, and full representation costs.

route_families.title: Restriction of scalars
route_families.scope: Represents the source object over a smaller base field without presuming a solver advantage from representation alone.
open_obligations: Record the exact functorial representation, dimensions, subgroup map, destination solver, recovery, and conversion costs.

route_families.title: Isomorphism, twist, and model changes
route_families.scope: Changes curve or coordinate representation through an explicit invertible or otherwise typed map.
open_obligations: Type the map, field of definition, inverse or recovery, subgroup action, exceptional points, and cost equivalence.

route_families.title: Isogeny transfer
route_families.scope: Transports a subgroup across a verified isogeny or isogeny chain and recovers the source answer.
open_obligations: Verify formulas, degree, kernels, field, subgroup-kernel intersection, dual or recovery, and destination advantage.

route_families.title: Field extension, lift, and descent
route_families.scope: Changes the working field and carries an explicit map and recovery obligation rather than inferring ease from extension degree.
open_obligations: Pin bases and conversions, prove subgroup preservation, account for extension arithmetic, and verify recovery over the source field.

route_families.title: Curve covers
route_families.scope: Uses an explicit morphism from a higher-genus or other source curve to the target elliptic curve, distinct from the trivial genus-one interpretation.
open_obligations: Audit theorem hypotheses and construct formulas, smoothness, genus, separability, infinity behavior, field of definition, and map identity.

route_families.title: Jacobian correspondences and transfer maps
route_families.scope: Moves divisor classes through explicit pullback, pushforward, or a typed correspondence and requires a destination solver and recovery.
open_obligations: Implement genuine divisor-class arithmetic and certify domains, homomorphism identities, kernels, subgroup preservation, and composition.

route_families.title: Explicit embeddings and quotients
route_families.scope: Uses a fully typed embedding, quotient, or decomposition representation with recovery of the source scalar.
open_obligations: Prove injectivity or characterize the kernel on the target subgroup and account for normalization, destination solving, and recovery.

route_families.title: Destination-group solver and source recovery
route_families.scope: Represents the solver and recovery component of a transfer route without reclassifying it as a source-group lane-A result.
open_obligations: Require actual destination relations or an independently verified destination algorithm, complete linear algebra, target decomposition, source recovery, failures, memory, and total cost.

lanes.title: Parameter asymmetry and provenance
lanes.decision_rule: Assign here when the record establishes a special property, generation condition, or retained witness; exploitation remains a separately linked lane-A or lane-B mechanism.

route_families.title: Order, cofactor, and smoothness properties
route_families.scope: Records exact order structure or subgroup/cofactor conditions without treating the property itself as an exploit.
open_obligations: Verify exact identities and orders, then link any exploitation to a separately evidenced mechanism.

route_families.title: Trace, embedding-degree, and supersingularity properties
route_families.scope: Records trace-derived conditions, embedding degree, or supersingularity; pairing or lift exploitation is separate.
open_obligations: Independently verify invariants for the exact model and subgroup and avoid inferring a transfer without explicit maps.

route_families.title: CM and endomorphism structure
route_families.scope: Records complex-multiplication, conductor, automorphism, or endomorphism conditions independently of an exploiting algorithm.
open_obligations: Verify the exact endomorphism ring or available action and link each algorithmic consequence separately.

route_families.title: Seeds, filtering, and generation provenance
route_families.scope: Audits published seeds, unexplained selection, rejection rules, and reproducibility of parameter generation.
open_obligations: Pin primary sources and generation transcripts, reproduce permitted choices, and distinguish missing provenance from malicious selection.

route_families.title: Retained trapdoor-witness hypotheses
route_families.scope: Represents a stipulated or evidenced retained witness separately from the mechanism it might enable and from secrecy assumptions.
open_obligations: Identify the witness, reconstruction boundary, equivalent public routes, activation costs, and linked exploitation mechanism.

route_families.title: Negotiation and downgrade parameter selection
route_families.scope: Records the ability to select or induce weaker parameters; protocol exploitation and access are separate linked records.
open_obligations: Pin protocol versions, negotiation transcript, authorization, validation behavior, and the separate route exploiting the selected parameter.

route_families.title: Catalog and parameter-identity errors
route_families.scope: Records mismatches in named parameters or representations; exploitability and evidence-integrity effects remain separately linked.
open_obligations: Resolve exact canonical identities and quantify whether the error changes mathematical, protocol, or evidence conclusions.

lanes.title: Protocol and implementation bypasses
lanes.decision_rule: Assign here when leakage, malformed input, an oracle, a fault, software behavior, or operational exposure recovers or exposes a secret while leaving the original DLP unsolved.

route_families.title: Nonce reuse, bias, and hidden-number routes
route_families.scope: Uses signature nonce failures or leakage under an exact protocol and observation model, not a solution of the underlying public-key DLP.
open_obligations: Specify leakage distribution, sample count, protocol version, safe fixtures, controls, recovery verification, and mitigations.

route_families.title: RNG and key-generation failures
route_families.scope: Exploits entropy, state, derivation, or generation failures under a versioned implementation and threat model.
open_obligations: Reproduce only with synthetic secrets and pin entropy assumptions, state access, affected revisions, output verification, and mitigation.

route_families.title: Invalid-curve, twist, and cofactor-validation bypasses
route_families.scope: Depends on missing or incorrect input, subgroup, twist, or cofactor validation in a bounded protocol implementation.
open_obligations: Pin validation behavior, accepted inputs, oracle access, query accounting, synthetic fixtures, and patched negative controls.

route_families.title: Timing, cache, electromagnetic, and power side channels
route_families.scope: Uses physical or microarchitectural observations under explicit proximity, access, device, and noise assumptions.
open_obligations: Specify device and revision, observation channel, traces, preprocessing, success rate, controls, generalization boundary, and mitigation.

route_families.title: Fault-injection routes
route_families.scope: Uses induced or naturally occurring faults under exact access and fault models to bypass the source DLP.
open_obligations: Record fault model, equipment or simulator, attempt failures, observability, target revision, verification, and countermeasure control.

route_families.title: Protocol-oracle routes
route_families.scope: Uses a versioned response, state, or error oracle with an explicit query and authorization model.
open_obligations: Pin oracle semantics, query limits, transcripts, false positives, recovery checks, and behavior after mitigation.

route_families.title: Arithmetic, parser, memory, and state bugs
route_families.scope: Depends on a concrete implementation defect or unsafe state transition rather than the hardness of the source group.
open_obligations: Bind findings to exact source and build revisions, safe reproductions, negative versions, impact boundaries, and fixes.

route_families.title: Logs, backups, HSM, firmware, and operational exposure
route_families.scope: Uses operationally exposed secret material or secret-derived state and therefore does not establish an ECDLP solution.
open_obligations: Use only synthetic evidence, specify access and custody, distinguish direct exposure from inference, and verify remediation.

lanes.title: Evidence and supply-chain integrity
lanes.decision_rule: Assign here when the record changes trust in identity, source, artifact, measurement, custody, or delivery; direct secret leakage remains a linked lane-D record.

route_families.title: Primary-source provenance
route_families.scope: Audits whether a scoped claim is traceable to pinned primary sources and exact quoted hypotheses.
open_obligations: Pin accessible primary sources, exact versions, quotations, hypotheses, and correction history.

route_families.title: Curve, subgroup, protocol, and artifact identity confusion
route_families.scope: Detects conclusions joined across nonidentical models, representations, subgroups, versions, or workloads.
open_obligations: Require canonical identities, typed crosswalks, subgroup and generator data, and representation-specific hashes.

route_families.title: Source, release, binary, and toolchain mismatch
route_families.scope: Audits whether documented source, built artifacts, released executables, and verification toolchains correspond exactly.
open_obligations: Bind revisions, lockfiles, compilers, build flags, artifacts, signatures, hashes, and reproducible-build receipts.

route_families.title: Measurement and accounting defects
route_families.scope: Detects omitted phases, mixed units, moving denominators, incomparable workloads, or incomplete failure accounting.
open_obligations: Apply the cross-route cost contract, matched controls, exclusive phase intervals, and replayable calculations.

route_families.title: Circular or non-independent verification
route_families.scope: Detects certificates or replays that reuse the producer, assumptions, implementation, or result they purport to verify.
open_obligations: Record independence level, producer/verifier separation, alternative oracle where feasible, and shared dependencies.

route_families.title: Dataset and evidence custody
route_families.scope: Audits immutability, content addressing, provenance, selection, exclusions, and custody of inputs and outputs.
open_obligations: Preserve hashes, byte counts, origins, transformations, exclusions, access controls, and additive correction records.

route_families.title: Dependency, build, and firmware compromise
route_families.scope: Represents integrity failures in dependencies, build infrastructure, firmware, or delivery separately from direct secret exposure.
open_obligations: Pin affected components and revisions, establish provenance and impact, and link any direct leakage to lane D.

route_families.title: Incident attribution and causal claims
route_families.scope: Audits whether observed compromise evidence supports a specific mathematical, protocol, implementation, or operational cause.
open_obligations: Separate observed facts, hypotheses, alternative causes, access limits, timelines, and evidentiary confidence.

route_families.title: Publication and survivorship bias
route_families.scope: Tracks missing failures, unpublished negative work, selective targets, and denominator changes that distort audit conclusions.
open_obligations: Freeze inclusion criteria and denominators, preserve failures and exclusions, and assess unavailable evidence explicitly.

route_families.title: Correction and promotion governance
route_families.scope: Audits whether evidence promotion, demotion, retraction, staleness, and additive corrections are independently controlled.
open_obligations: Bind role separation, decision records, exact evidence revisions, correction lineage, and fail-closed transitions.

hybrid_edges.open_obligation: Check the exact embedding condition and pairing map before composing the property and transfer records.
Verify the precise anomalous-order hypothesis rather than treating any trace observation as sufficient.
Verify the usable subgroup action and charge equivalence-class and canonicalization costs.
Bind the order facts to the exact malformed-input acceptance behavior and oracle.
Do not infer a withheld isogeny from unexplained selection; require a witness or a falsifiable reconstruction protocol.
A cover alone is insufficient; certify induced divisor-class maps, subgroup behavior, destination solving, and recovery.
Require an actual destination-group relation solver; elliptic norm projection is not a Jacobian index-calculus solver, and a destination solver is not a source-group lane-A result.
Pin the original theorem, exact hypotheses, and constructive scope before assessing an implementation against it.
Bind executable artifacts to reviewed source and exact solver evidence before accepting a replay.
Do not convert an unexplained incident into evidence of secret exposure or an algebraic attack without causal evidence.

open_obligations: Complete the cited WS6 corpus protocol and reconcile candidate families against primary sources.
Obtain independent non-overlap review of every route and typed hybrid edge.
Freeze exact route and asset populations before reporting any completeness percentage.
Integrate schema and semantic checks into the native authoritative-ledger validator.
Populate route-specific evidence, controls, costs, and authorization only through reviewed assessment records.
non_claims: This seed is not a complete historical or present-day attack inventory.
No listed route is supported, refuted, applicable, or operational merely because it appears here.
No entry authorizes production-target testing or private-key recovery.
A bounded search or empty evidence list is not proof of nonexistence or security.
A lane-D bypass is not counted as a lane-A ECDLP solution.
